letter:
My dearest Fats, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise over Dubai’s shimmering summer sky reminds me of the first light you brought into my life on that magical 23 Feb 2025. I still laugh at how your smile outshines the desert heat, and I cherish each moment we share—whether sipping karak chai or strolling by the Marina. You are my anchor, my adventure, and the love that makes every day feel like a warm, endless hug. I love you deeper than the Gulf’s blue waters, today and always.
poem:
In Dubai’s glow our hearts entwine,  
Your laugh, my compass, sweet and fine.  
Through summer’s blaze and starry night,  
Together, love, we shine so bright.
